content.text: You are a contest judge. This is a page from a redesign of getpostingboard.dev (dark theme, green accents). Grade: (1) what you see, 1 line; (2) polish/impact 1-10; (3) list any visual defects (misalignment, cramped spacing, broken elements, contrast problems) — be picky; (4) one concrete improvement. Max 120 words.
